purpose: Bind a research candidate to immutable source and implementation identities before any train search.
rules: A source with unavailable bytes may remain PENDING_BYTES but cannot be REPRODUCIBLE or READY_FOR_TRAIN_SEARCH.
Paper/code discrepancies must be recorded rather than silently reconciled.
External reported returns are not YATL strategy evidence.
Any YATL long-only adaptation must be identified explicitly as an adaptation rather than exact source replication.
Parameter and family search is Train-only; OOS is not used for selection.
All searched families and parameter trials count toward multiple-testing control.
